text_block_list.text:
Her resolve thus renewed, Нарита Таисин
and I set
our sights on the spring Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
An injury forces Уиннинг Тикит to pull
out of the
race, leaving Нарита Таисин
and Бива Хаяхидэ to
battle it out,
one-on-one.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Will Нарита Таисин's powerful finishing
sprint win?
Or will Бива Хаяхидэ's
winning equation bring
her to victory?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The curtain is set to rise on the tense
battle
between the two racers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
